name: design-engineering
description: Design engineering for AI agents — a navigable skill graph covering animation timing, transitions, typography, color, components, layout, accessibility, anti-patterns, sound, SVG, launch films and faux product UI, plus thirteen subagents (ten workflow agents plus a cross-model design council, a design judge and a design grader), generated for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and eve, and an eve runtime with an MCP channel. Distills Emil Kowalski, Benji Taylor, Jakub Antalik, guidelines.sh, Vercel, Ben DC, DiceBear, lucide-animated, Google Labs design.md, Agentation, and Index.
